lines.en: The archangel Uriel had appeared in the 73rd Demon Realm.
Even in the original novel, Uriel sometimes descended directly into an incarnation body in the later chapters. But this was only the 25th scenario.
I could hear the bewildered Demon Kings and constellations muttering.
[Th-this is absurd…….]
Uriel's translucent figure seemed to shimmer behind Jung Heewon, whose eyes were peacefully closed. Amid a dazzling aura, Uriel's long golden hair rippled through the air.
Tzzzzzzzt!

The scales of probability were tipping again. The scales, which had been completely out of balance, were slowly evening out with Uriel's arrival alone. No, it almost seemed that our side now weighed more.
More astonishing still was that this wasn't Uriel's full power.
Rrrrrrrumble!
All fighting on the battlefield stopped. Surya watched us tensely, and the constellations embroiled in the melee halted their fierce battles.
An archangel's descent was an enormous event even for constellations.
The first to speak was the owl-faced Demon King holding a flaming sword.
[Archangel! How dare you…… Do you know where you are?!]
I knew him.
‘Maker of Discord.’ ‘Andras,’ the Demon King of the 63rd Demon Realm.
He had once cursed Han Sooyoung for killing one of his subordinates.
Then the other Demon King beside him spoke.
[You must want to become a c-c-corpse, archangel.]
A skeleton wearing green armor and a crown.
‘Monarch who is a Philosopher about Corpses.’ It was ‘Murmur,’ the Demon King of the 54th Demon Realm.
Though they were lower-ranking Demon Kings, both were powerful beings in an entirely different league from me. Yet an unfamiliar emotion was seeping into their expressions. It was
fear.
Having completed her descent, Uriel slowly opened her eyes.
As her luminous emerald eyes surveyed the world with haughty disdain, it felt as though the world's colors changed. Even without meeting her gaze, I felt my heart freeze.
[Constellation, ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’, looks upon the ‘73rd Demon Realm’.]
An archangel's gaze portended ‘ruin.’ A gaze that took one final look at every living thing in the world before purifying it. The ‘73rd Demon Realm’ was trembling under her gaze.
[You ■■. Long time no see, huh?]
The two Demon Kings retreated three or four steps.
One corner of Jung Heewon's mouth lifted slightly.
[You…… Didn't I tell you before to stop carrying that sword around? I said it pisses me off because our character concepts overlap.]
At those words, Demon King Andras quietly lowered his flaming sword. His owl eyes blinked rapidly, and Murmur's skeletal jaw was shaking violently.
Murmur was the first to take a step forward.
[Foolish archangel! Do you understand what your actions mean?! Or…… Don't tell me E-Eden has decided to intervene in the ‘Selection’…….]
[■ off. I came because I felt like it.]
I was reminded anew of Uriel's characterization.
Her warmth toward me had made me completely forget, but she was one of <Eden>'s most terrifying archangels.
Demon-like Judge of Fire.
A battle maniac more brutal than any other archangel, and the archangel who had slaughtered the most demons.
When she raised her hand into the air, a sword shimmering with white flames appeared in it. Before her sword, every fire nearby went out as if paying its respects.
A sword containing the most sublime flames of [Hell Flames Ignition].
It was Uriel's Star Relic, [Flames of Retribution].
When she went so far as to draw her sword, the Demon Kings' expressions grew frantic.
[Have you forgotten the treaty?]
[Eat ■. You ■-like ■■.]
[Wh-what?]
[Ah, ■, this ■-like filtering…….]
I remembered that, according to the novel's setting, the nebula <Eden> imposed its own filtering on its archangels to preserve their dignity.
It was then that Uriel's eyes turned toward me.
[Kim Dokja?]
Had I looked too startled?
Uriel turned toward me with an awkward smile.
It was an awkward greeting, as though she was embarrassed that I'd seen that side of her.
[Many constellations are at a loss for words.]
[Constellation, ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon’, points a finger at her, telling her to stop making a fool of herself.]
The Demon Kings who had been so horribly threatened just moments ago were staring our way in disbelief. I came to my senses and bowed.
“It's been a while, Uriel.”
[Yeah!]
Uriel beamed.
[You are loved by an archangel!]
[You have acquired a new Story!]
[You have acquired the Story, ‘One Loved by an Archangel’!]

A barrage of indirect messages brimming with consideration rained down, perhaps because she was worried I would be frightened. Honestly, I was a little moved. Quite a few constellations had shown me goodwill. But none had worked as hard to help me as Uriel.
I had done nothing for her.
Only ever on the receiving end.
And yet Uriel had come here today for me.
Rolling up both of Jung Heewon's sleeves, Uriel cried out triumphantly.
[Don't worry, Kim Dokja! I'll kill them all for you!]
I knew it was a performance.
This was the Demon Realm.
It was perfectly clear what would happen if an archangel truly unleashed her power here.
Still, just hearing Uriel say that was enough…….
“……Uriel?”
Roooooar!
“Wait! Uriel!”

The flames erupting from the tip of Uriel's sword stretched endlessly upward, reaching the sky. That was the true [Hell Flames Ignition]. Uriel's real power, capable of turning an entire world into a sea of fire with a single strike.
[Th-the archangel's gone mad! Run!]
[She's a crazy bitch!]
The terrified constellations began to flee. I hadn't expected Uriel to actually unleash her power either. At last, even Dokgak emerged from wherever he'd been hiding.
[W-wait a moment, Archangel-nim. Please calm down……!]
His sly behavior made my blood boil.
He'd abandoned the scenario, even delaying the announcement of the winner, and now…….
As though she had read my mind, Uriel said,
[■ off.]
[P-pardon?]
[■ the scenario! ■ the dokkaebis! ■, you ■-like bastards.]
Uriel looked truly furious.
The Demon Realm's sky howled with her anger.
Rrrrrrrrumble!
The moment the archangel's sword was about to strike the earth.
[Demon King, ‘Immeasurable Being’, erupts in fury.]
Black magic power raged violently in the sky.
[Demon King, ‘Ruler of Eastern Hell’, stares at the archangel.]
[Demon King, ‘Demon God of Necromancy’, raises their Status.]
[Demon King, ‘Black Mane Lion’, bellows at Eden.]
Demon Kings of the highest Status, whose modifiers alone were terrifying, were appearing in the channel one by one.
Damn it. At this rate, the Great War of Saints and Demons might break out right here.
But Demon Kings weren't the only ones to appear.
[Constellation, ‘Guardian of Youths and Travel’, has entered the channel.]
[Constellation, ‘Lily Blooming in Aquarius’, has entered the channel.]
[Constellation, ‘Commander of the Red Cosmos’, has entered the channel.]
Constellations of the highest Status, whose mere appearance could put everyone on edge.
As <Eden>'s leading constellations entered, the channel's volume swelled rapidly. Biyoo trembled in my arms as though in pain.
[Constellation, ‘Scribe of Heaven’, looks upon ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ with a stern gaze.]
Uriel's sword twitched.
It felt as though time had frozen.
Every Demon King and archangel was focused on Uriel's sword.
The future of the Demon Realm and Eden depended on where that sword went.
[The Demon Kings of the Demon Realm and the archangels of Eden have convened an emergency meeting.]
Tzzzzzt!
[Effective immediately, all Demon Kings and archangels in this scenario are summoned to an emergency assembly.]
With the sound of an immense mass of probability shifting, Uriel's sword dissipated in midair.
Jung Heewon's body swayed, and the archangel's presence was leaving the Demon Realm.
Uriel looked at me with a faint smile and said,
[I wanted to help you until the end.]
Only then did I realize Uriel's intention.
[N-no! This cannot be!]
Uriel wasn't the only one disappearing. The Demon Kings who had descended earlier were also slowly vanishing amid sparks of probability.
By sacrificing herself, Uriel had tied the hands of every Demon King here.
[……Remarkable.]
Cheok Jungyeong murmured, apparently impressed.
[To think that august archangel would make such a great sacrifice for you…….]
I, too, could anticipate the punishment Uriel would have to bear.
An archangel who had violated the treaty of the Great War of Saints and Demons of her own free will.
She would probably face extraordinarily harsh sanctions from <Eden>.
[You have to win, Kim Dokja.]

I reached toward the fading Uriel, but her figure had already scattered into gray. I quickly caught Jung Heewon as she collapsed. Having borne the full weight of Uriel's Status, she was asleep, her face utterly exhausted.
Whoooooosh!
I looked up as the wind pressure of Status resounded through the sky. There was Surya, who had watched all of this unfold.
[My judgment was wrong. I never imagined you were a constellation capable of summoning an archangel.]
Thanks to Uriel, we no longer needed to worry about the Demon Kings joining the battle.
But something had also taken a turn for the worse.
Surya's eyes, which had looked upon me with subtle contempt all this time, were now utterly serious.
The same was true of King Oedipus and Manu, who guarded his flanks.
[From this moment on, I will fight in earnest.]
Surya shot up through the sky like an arrow. The surrounding air seemed to change, and then tremendous winds began to rage through the area.
And a moment later.
Rrrrrrroar!
“Wh-what's that sound?”
My scattered companions gathered beside me one by one.
The first to speak was Jang Hayoung, utterly exhausted.
“When the hell is this going to end…… What's that now?”
Beyond the radiant sun, something was flying toward us through the distant cosmos. A sonic boom tearing the atmosphere to shreds.
It sounded like something one might hear only when a meteorite struck.
Looking closely, I saw that what was flying toward us was a gigantic chariot.
Each time the monstrously huge golden mare accelerated, the entire Demon Realm shook as though it would burst.
“……A chariot?”
Could something like that be called a chariot? Or should I call it a locomotive? Neither word fit.
What was certain was that an object of a size beyond human comprehension was racing toward us.
And that it would become this world's disaster.
Yoo Sangah spoke.
“Surya's chariot. According to legend, it's over 130,000 kilometers long…….”
“130,000? Does that even make sense?”
At Jang Hayoung's question, Yoo Sangah shook her head and said,
“……I suppose that's why it's a myth.”
These were the gods of Indian mythology, who claimed that giant turtles and elephants held up the Earth. So the appearance of a locomotive on such an enormous scale wasn't particularly strange.
Rrrrrrrumble!
The problem was that we had to face that disaster.
[You have witnessed part of the Giant Story, ‘Vedas’.]
[Your understanding of Stories increases.]
……So this was what Surya meant by ‘in earnest.’
I marveled at the ‘Status’ that made every hair on my body stand on end.
The mere fact that it was approaching us filled me with overwhelming despair.
Power on an entirely different plane from an ordinary ‘Story,’ though I had witnessed only a ‘part.’
That was precisely why I had to obtain a [Giant Story].
[Damn it, run!]
Faced with the imposing chariot charging through the sky, several constellations had already tucked tail and disappeared.
Constellation or otherwise, no being could take a hit from that and emerge unscathed.
Cheok Jungyeong gave a low groan and said,
[This has become a real problem. It seems he intends to destroy this world.]
“……Are you frightened?”
[No. This should be fun.]
Cheok Jungyeong laughed as though he was truly enjoying himself.
Just as I was about to say something to my companions, someone stood tall beside me.
He was neither Cheok Jungyeong nor a constellation.
“……You're awake?”
I turned to see Yoo Joonghyuk standing, using the [Black Heavenly Demon Sword] for support.
[Character ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ activates ‘Recovery Lv.10’!]
Yoo Joonghyuk's body had finally recovered enough to use ‘Recovery.’ Every last bit of his remaining life force blazed brightly at the tip of his jet-black sword.
His mouth and vocal cords seemed slower to recover; he said nothing.
Instead, his thoughts reached me through ‘Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint.’
「Kim Dokja.」
“Yeah.”
This would probably be the final battle in the Demon Realm.
[The ‘73rd Demon Realm’ focuses on your choice.]
This time, even I couldn't guarantee anything.
Someone here might die.
Perhaps I or Yoo Joonghyuk might die.
Even so, I said,
“Let's go.”
Yoo Sangah and Lee Hyunsung nodded, and Shin Yoosung drew up beside me atop the Chimera Dragon. Lee Jihye, who had been watching the sky from the moat, nodded too.
There were no more constellations to help us.
Now, there were only humans here.
But this wasn't a battle without a chance of victory.
We had already bought enough time.
All thanks to Uriel.
[The will of the ‘73rd Demon Realm’ responds to your choice.]
Perhaps Surya had made a mistake by getting serious.
We wouldn't be the only ones to meet our end before the approaching disaster.
Just as <First Murim> had when faced with its destruction scenario, this <73rd Demon Realm> had reached its moment of choice.
[The ‘Giant Story’ of the ‘73rd Demon Realm’ begins to sprout.]
And no world would choose a being bent on destroying it as its master.
[The ‘73rd Demon Realm’ has chosen its master.]
Bewildered dokkaebis and constellations sent out a burst of messages.
But I listened to none of their voices.
Because right now, I wasn't the one listening to the story. I was the one telling it.
[Your ‘Giant Story’ begins its tale.]
Having leaped into the heavens, Surya looked down at the ground with conflicted eyes.
Surrounded by radiant light, the ‘73rd Demon Realm’ was pouring the sentences it had woven into a single being.
Rrrrrrrumble!
The sight of a world choosing its master before the vast destruction hurtling toward it from space.
Surya murmured.
[A being who has obtained a ‘Giant Story’ in only the twenty-fifth scenario…… Has there ever been such a being in the <Star Stream>?]
Even after his long life, Surya could think of no name. Only Heracles of Olympus came to mind. But even he had not been wholly human; he was a demigod (半神). King Oedipus shouted.
[Surya, it is all right. Now, when it has only just sprouted, you can crush it with ease!]
A ‘Giant Story’ was a story on an entirely different plane from other Stories.
A story that was both the sum of countless Stories and, in itself, a guarantee of tremendous probability.

But however much of a ‘Giant Story’ it might be, this one had only just sprouted. And the ‘Demon King of Salvation’ who would possess it was merely a lowly being who had lucked into constellationhood.
Yet for some reason, Surya couldn't easily feel certain.
[Surya, what is the matter? You should finish this quickly…….]
Every ‘Giant Story’ implied ‘the beginning of the end.’
A story heading toward the full stop of this grand scenario.
But not everyone who obtained a ‘Giant Story’ gained ‘Qualification for the End.’ Some ‘Giant Stories’ were connected to ■■, while others vanished without ever coming close to ■■.
—Because you, Surya, haven't obtained the ‘Qualification for the End’.
He couldn't forget those words Asmodeus had left him with.
Amid his quiet anger, a message sounded in Surya's ears.
[You have been assigned a new scenario!]
[You will become the ‘Destruction of the 73rd Demon Realm’.]
Surya frowned at the unwanted role.
‘O <Star Stream>. What do you want from this old being?’

He had lost one of his twelve suns to Cheok Jungyeong and expended a considerable amount of mental energy dealing with Asmodeus. On top of that, he had already exhausted most of the probability allotted to him.
[Surya. There is no need to take the conventional route. I have an idea. A way to bring them mercilessly to their knees, without even fighting—]
Surya frowned.
[Oedipus. Do you intend to resort to another despicable trick? Against mere humans?]
[Th-that is not what I…….]
[I am Surya, the ‘Supreme God of Light’.]
The sentences of the great Vedas shone within Surya's halo.
[Even if I cannot wield my full power, I will never lose to a human.]
Before that overwhelming display of ‘Status,’ Oedipus, who had been about to say something, closed his mouth.
Surya raised his hand, and the chariot, which had briefly faltered, resumed its furious charge.
Rooooooar!
The locomotive thundered as it pierced the sky and entered the atmosphere.
Red and blue flames flew from its red-hot front.
Yoo Joonghyuk, whose voice had recovered, spoke first.
“It doesn't appear to be 135,000 kilometers.”
True, if a train of that scale had actually appeared, it would have looked like an enormous planet on a collision course. Cheok Jungyeong responded.
[The younger man's right. At most, it is some 30 kilometers long. But that is large enough to destroy this place. Demon King of Salvation, what has become of the ‘Giant Story’?]
“It has only just begun its tale. The sentences are gathering slowly.”
I had safely obtained the Giant Story of the ‘73rd Demon Realm.’
But obtaining it didn't mean everything was over.
“We need more time before it can properly exert its power. We have to slow the train down.”
That ‘train’ was probably everything Surya could muster right now.
If we could just stop it, we had a chance of winning.
When I turned, Cheok Jungyeong was already preparing to leap.
“I'm counting on you, Goryeo's First Sword.”
[Have faith in me.]
Booooom!
Cheok Jungyeong pushed off with tremendous force and shot into the air like a cannonball.
Yoo Joonghyuk and I followed him, and the rest of our companions followed on Shin Yoosung's [Chimera Dragon].
‘Thunder Eating Bird’ and ‘Mysterious Bird of the Nile’ took flight to obstruct us, but ‘Brash Swamp Predator’ tore into the bases of their wings with its teeth.
[Leave these ones to me.]

The closer we came to the front of the train, the more I began to grasp the enormous scale of <Vedas>. Its front alone was hundreds of meters wide. Its scale seemed capable of rivaling even an ordinary ‘Outer God.’
[Haaaaaaaah!]
With a battle cry, Cheok Jungyeong unleashed his Three Sword Style.
Second Form, Second Sword Cuts the Mountain (二劍斬山).
Cheok Jungyeong's mountain-cleaving sword technique struck the train directly.
The train's front gave off a strange sound as it collided with his ‘Status.’
Crrrrrrunch!
Ne-e-e-e-eigh!
The startled horse at the front veered off course, but the train didn't slow in the slightest. In that appalling heat, it was Cheok Jungyeong's sword tip that began to melt.
But Cheok Jungyeong continued the Three Sword Style without stopping.
Third Form, Third Sword Cuts the Sea (三劍斬海).

A strike that cleaved the sea. With a sensation like the scattering foam of a tidal wave, the train's speed diminished slightly for the first time. The greater achievement was that the leading carriage exploded, creating an entrance inside.
[It will be easier to advance from inside! I'll slow it down from out here!]
I could see Cheok Jungyeong unleashing fierce magic power at the front of the train.
But even Cheok Jungyeong would struggle to handle an object moving at this speed all by himself.
“I'll help too, ajusshi!”

Shin Yoosung's ‘Chimera Dragon’ joined Cheok Jungyeong at the front of the train. As the grade 2 monster species ‘Chimera Dragon’ generated powerful wind pressure, the train slowed further. Cheok Jungyeong shouted.
[We should be able to buy about twenty minutes somehow. Surya will be in the very last carriage. You must defeat him for this Story to disappear! Go!]
We nodded and entered the train.
The train looked like a subway built for giants. Once we had more or less adjusted to its inertia, we immediately pressed the button to enter the next carriage.
[The door will not open.]
[Only constellations of <Vedas> may use this train.]
Activating [Breaking the Sky Swordsmanship], Yoo Joonghyuk struck the door without hesitation. But it only dented inward and did not open.
“……Sturdy.”
Contrary to Cheok Jungyeong's expectations, the train's interior was formidable too.
It wasn't so strong that Yoo Joonghyuk or I couldn't break through if we properly exerted our Status, but the train was a full 30 kilometers long.
In other words, we had to consider how to ration our strength.
That was when the first sentence of the ‘Giant Story’ reached us.
「That story began on a subway.」
Tzzzzzt!

Along with the surging sparks, the Stories I possessed were unraveling into the air. It felt like a wave rolling in from far away. It was a trace of a very old story. I looked back, and my companions seemed to be feeling something similar.
[Your ‘Giant Story’ begins its first tale.]
Yoo Joonghyuk, Lee Hyunsung, and Yoo Sangah were looking at me.
The sparks flowing in like a rising tide were transforming our surroundings completely. Lee Hyunsung murmured in wonder.
“Th-this place…….”
Every ‘Giant Story’ held a different tale within it.
Some contained the narrative of a hero's birth; others, the Story of a world's birth. But our story was neither a hero's life nor a creation Story.
This story was our ‘record of survival.’
The number [3807] written on the train's rear door.
Looking around, Yoo Sangah let out a sigh.
“……It's that subway.”
Every Story activated 「Stage Transformation」 when places or people connected to it came together.
—Carriage 3807 of train 3434, bound for Bulgwang.
It was here that Yoo Sangah and Lee Hyunsung became my companions, and I met Yoo Joonghyuk.
All our stories had begun right here.
Clenching his fists beside me, Lee Hyunsung spoke with a tense expression.
“……This takes me back.”
“They certainly weren't good memories, but…….”
Yoo Sangah, too, was looking at me with a faint smile.
“Even so, I often thought back to this time.”
These weren't memories we could recall fondly.
Someone's death, and the hell of an absurd scenario.
It was a time that could inspire neither longing nor fond remembrance…… And yet it was undeniably a history we had survived.
With a smile that looked close to tears, Lee Hyunsung placed a hand on the door.
“Somehow, I think I can do it.”
「There was a soldier who had wanted to be just.」
In the end, everything becomes a story.
The hardships, the sorrows, even the things we wanted to forget.
Once they have passed, they all become stories.
“Haaaaaaaah!”
I couldn't know whether that would comfort us now.
There was only one thing we could know.
[Constellation, ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’, watches your party.]
[Constellation, ‘Secretive Plotter’, listens to your Story.]
That in a world where neither sorrow nor joy served any purpose, we had to keep that story going.
Crrrrrrrunch!

The door that hadn't opened even under Yoo Joonghyuk's [Breaking the Sky Swordsmanship] began to yield to Lee Hyunsung's tremendous strength. The ‘Giant Story’ dwelling throughout his body was exerting its power.
[Character ‘Lee Hyunsung’ activates the stigma ‘Great Mountain Push Lv.10’!]
Come to think of it, back then too, Lee Hyunsung had opened the door to our escape.
“Go. Quickly!”
Our party ran through the gap Lee Hyunsung had forced open. But we had only opened a single door, and the train was still long. This time, Yoo Joonghyuk took the lead.
“I'll break through the next one.”
A memory from long ago suddenly surfaced.
The regressor who had wiped out the train's other incarnations and charged forward like a merciless tank was now standing before me.
「There was the strongest and loneliest man in the world,」
Having put away his sword, Yoo Joonghyuk was concentrating all his magic power into his fist. Come to think of it, he'd broken down the door with his bare fist back then.
Booooom!
The carriage door that hadn't budged beneath his sword was being torn apart like paper by his bare fist.
This was the effect of 「Stage Transformation」.
It was Surya's misfortune that his main Story was this ‘train.’
“Dokja-ssi! I don't think we need to break this carriage's door!”
Yoo Sangah shouted, apparently having worked something out. Just as she had found the door mechanism back then, she had once again found a way to open a carriage without using force.
「A woman who had hidden herself for the sake of others was there too.」
One carriage, then another.
We began to advance.
As though living through our history all over again.
Boom! Kabooom!
The sound of naval guns pounding the train reached us from outside.
Lee Jihye seemed to be fighting hard to slow the train down too.
「They met a Scarred Sword Demon who had lost someone dear.」
I heard the Chimera Dragon roar.
Biyoo raised her head from my arms and looked toward the front of the train.
Precisely in Shin Yoosung's direction.
「A child born in the gap between past and future cried.」
The next moment, the Chimera Dragon let out a tremendous roar and exerted itself.
The train seemed to lurch, and its acceleration diminished further.
Grrrrroar!
I wasn't sure, but I wondered if Biyoo had conveyed something to the Shin Yoosung here.
“We aren't even halfway yet. We have to hurry.”
As Yoo Joonghyuk said, despite our companions' efforts, the end of the train was still far away.
We had already been delayed by more than ten minutes.
Even with its speed reduced, at this rate, the space-time around the [Industrial Complex] would be completely destroyed.
To make matters worse, when we opened the next carriage, we encountered an obstacle.
A spear shot toward us like a flash of light. Lee Hyunsung stepped in front of me, then crumpled, clutching his shoulder.
[You go no farther.]
‘Manu,’ the Founder of Humanity, and several constellations were waiting there.
Yoo Joonghyuk immediately unleashed [Breaking the Sky Swordsmanship] and fought them, but he lacked the strength to break through the constellations' defenses.
Tzzzzzzzt!
It was as though they knew all they had to do was stall us here.
Just as I gritted my teeth and prepared to use the magic power I had saved.
Crrrrrrunch!
The train's ceiling began to cave in.
Someone was destroying the train from outside with tremendous magic power.
[Wh-what…… What on earth is that?!]
At least a Narrative-grade constellation. Only a being with power comparable to Cheok Jungyeong's could destroy this train's outer shell.
“Out of the waaaaaay!”
Jang Hayoung's voice came from outside the train.
“Kim Dokja! They're here! They've come!”
The next moment, the entire ceiling was ripped away, and two beings appeared alongside Jang Hayoung.
[A small constellation from a small planet looks at you.]
A tiny man wrapped in the radiance of White Pure, and a huge woman streaming a dark-blue aura. Ridiculously enough, for a moment I thought my vision might blur.
“Where is my disciple?”
「He had the world's strongest small person as his master.」
“It seems we're a little late.”
「He saved the world of the world's strongest giant.」
Powerful beings who could rival Cheok Jungyeong and who might help us.
[Transcendents……!]
As Manu ground his teeth, two transcendents who vied for the title of strongest in <First Murim> descended before him.
The Breaking the Sky Sword Saint, Namgung Minyoung.
The Paradox Baekchung, Kyrgios Rodgraim.
Glancing our way, Namgung Minyoung said,
“See this through properly. Otherwise, you'll get a spanking.”
Kyrgios also glared at me before speaking.
“You will pay for deceiving me. Until then, I will not permit you to die.”
Kyrgios and the Breaking the Sky Sword Saint unleashed their martial arts toward the door of the next carriage.
The energies of [Breaking the Sky Swordsmanship] and [Electrification] converged, generating a terrifying blast of wind.
For an instant, even the constellations shrank back before its force.
Rooooooar!
A terrifying wave of magic power surged forward, shattering all the doors barring our way at once. A straight path opened in an instant. The moment our eyes met, Yoo Joonghyuk and I were running.
[Exclusive skill, ‘Way of the Wind Lv.11(+1)’, has been activated!]
With [Way of the Wind] and [Red Phoenix Shunpo] working at full power to support each other, we ran. Before long, we reached the train's final carriage.
「And there was a man who knew the ending of all these worlds.」
This was a Story that had not existed in ‘Ways of Survival.’
A story that had never existed before.
And for that very reason, a Story that could finally lead me to the ending I wanted.
I threw open the train's final door.
Surya was beyond the final door.

As Yoo Joonghyuk's fist smashed the door, a hollow wind swept in, revealing a wide-open view of the heavens. The rear of the last carriage, where Surya stood, had been severed as though something had torn it away.
[You arrived sooner than expected.]
Surya spoke with his back to us, gazing out at the heavens.
A square of cosmos visible beyond the severed train.
The supreme god's light stretched into the darkness.
Like a hand sifting through grains of sand on a vast beach.
I deliberately spoke in a courteous tone.
“Surya, let's stop here.”
The god's light, unable to reach the principles of the cosmos, turned toward me.
Surya's eyes were glaring at me.
His gaze seemed to say that even if he couldn't understand the <Star Stream>, there was no way he couldn't read someone as insignificant as me.
[A man who knows the ending of every world…… A truly arrogant Story.]
Apparently, Surya had heard the sentence from my ‘Giant Story’ too.
Before I could answer, King Oedipus, standing beside Surya, replied.
[It is merely a metaphor. A play on words.]
It was actually a relief if that was what he thought.
I had already been feeling uneasy about how directly the Story revealed information about me.
[Constellation, ‘Mass Production Maker’, is curious about your sentence.]
[Constellation, ‘God of Wine and Ecstasy’, is curious about your Giant Story.]
Whooooosh!
[Constellation, ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’, tells you to stay on guard.]
[Constellation, ‘Maritime War God’, clenches his fists.]
[Constellation, ‘Secretive Plotter’, looks at you.]
The way Surya looked at me was changing.
I realized that nothing I said here could stop him.
[Come at me, child. You have 10 minutes.]
Tzzzzzzzzt!
Surya's four arms assumed a fighting stance. His body slowly grew as he released his Status. He used no weapon. He intended to eliminate me through the pure power of his Stories alone.
[In 10 minutes, this chariot will collide with the ‘Demon Realm’.]
As though there was no need to delay any further, Yoo Joonghyuk charged first.
A dark-blue aura reminiscent of the Breaking the Sky Sword Saint rose from his entire body. His [Breaking the Sky Swordsmanship], brought to a new height, blossomed in ominous rays of light.
I wasn't the only one affected by the ‘Giant Story.’
Yoo Joonghyuk, who also held a share in this Story.
Even with his body still damaged, he could now wield power comparable to a constellation's.
Krrrrrrang!
The grating clash of blade and long staff.
It wasn't Surya who had intercepted Yoo Joonghyuk's attack.
[Grrrrgh……!]
King Oedipus was facing Yoo Joonghyuk, groaning in pain.
[Gaaaaaaaah!]
Though he was squeezing every ounce of power from his overheated incarnation body, Oedipus seemed to be struggling against Yoo Joonghyuk.
“Kim Dokja!”
At Yoo Joonghyuk's shout, I broke through Oedipus's defenses and leaped toward Surya. In the air inside the train, Surya, now several times his original size, met me.
[Exclusive skill, ‘Electrification Lv.12(+2)’, has been activated!]
Rays of Electrification wrapped around me, and the lightning of White Pure struck Surya's chest.
Before, Surya had blocked my [Electrification] with just one hand.
But this time was different.
Tssssss!
Surya's skin was scorching where the lightning of White Pure touched it.
It had done some damage, however slight.
Surya's eyebrows twitched in surprise.
Booooom!
I collided with Surya's fist and went flying. The impact felt as though it had shaken my heart, but I could endure it.
[The power of the ‘Giant Story’ protects you.]
The world's sentences swirled around me.
Power that allowed me to contend with that mighty Narrative-grade constellation.
This was a ‘Giant Story.’
But Surya was still standing strong.
[……I believe I told you. You cannot win with skills learned by theft.]
Perhaps Surya was right.
I had always fought with other people's techniques.
“I didn't learn these by stealing. I read them.”
[Read?]
As Persephone had said, to exist was to be a story.
Memories of sentences I had read every single day for years.
Everything I had read and seen had become who I was now.
[Exclusive skill, ‘Fourth Wall’, activates strongly!]
Whooooosh!
The sentences of the Giant Story appeared on the ‘Fourth Wall.’
「This is the Story of a reader (讀者, dokja).」
I ran toward Surya. Along the path of my charge flowed the countless hours I had spent reading stories alone.
It had been an ordinary life.
The hours spent shut away in a dark room, reading ‘Ways of Survival’ alone.
On the bus after my part-time job, in the military's computer room, in a classroom between lectures, and again on the subway home from work…….
「At the same time, the Story of an only child (獨子, dokja).」
I had lived in that world alone.
Identifying with countless characters, I had become someone else over and over.
[With a mere Story like this…….]
Thus, I was a regressor who had never regressed.
[Exclusive skill, ‘Way of the Wind Lv.11(+1)’, has been activated!]
A returnee who had never experienced a return.
[Bookmark No. 3 has been activated.]
[Exclusive skill, ‘Beast King’s Sensitivity Lv.10(+1)’, is active!]
And perhaps, a reincarnator too.
Boooooom!
As he clashed with my ‘Status,’ Surya's face was slowly contorting.
Each time our Statuses collided, I could feel our incarnation bodies breaking down. Both Surya and I were drawing on every bit of power we could muster and smashing it against each other.
[This much will never suffice! It falls absurdly short of gaining ‘Qualification for the End’!]
I shook my head.
“You seem to have the wrong idea. ‘great Stories’ aren't the only ones that can reach the ‘end.’”
Surya probably wouldn't understand.
After all, I too had learned that through Yoo Joonghyuk's countless failures.
Rrrrrumble!
His expression hardening, Surya concentrated tremendous power into his four arms.
This would probably be his final attack.
Without retreating, I met him with the power of [Electrification].
An all-melting flash of sunlight shot toward me.
Unable to withstand the flash's intense heat, the lightning of White Pure was gradually being driven back.
As I retreated one step, then another, a rough and lonely Story enveloped me from behind.
I didn't need to look back to know whose Story it was.
Tzzzzzt!
The sparks flashing between Surya and me grew fiercer still.
Slowly, my retreating steps came to a halt.
[Constellation, ‘Master of Steel’, looks at you.]
[Constellation, ‘Master of the Skywalk’, looks at you.]
Lee Hyunsung and Yoo Sangah. I could feel Jung Heewon's Story too.
The histories of everyone who had struggled to survive were dwelling within me in their entirety.
「The woman who had awakened after so long curled in on herself and taken up a blade to destroy evil smiled.」
There were also those who shared that history, though they weren't here.
「The boy who had lost his mother and held an insect in his hand cried,」
「And the man who had built a fortress for a family that would never return roared.」
Lee Gilyoung and Gong Pildu.
「The woman who had built truth out of lies willingly became his shadow.」
And even Han Sooyoung.
Tzzzzzt!
[Exclusive attribute, ‘Scenario Interpreter’, activates!]
Every path my life had taken became a story and formed a road.
Surya's incarnation body was right before me.
Surya's weakness, which even the Duke of Loyalty and Warfare's stigma hadn't been able to read. Yet strangely, in that moment, I felt I knew where to stab him.
[Exclusive skill, ‘Reading Comprehension’, activates!]
[Unbreakable Faith] shone brightly, and the concentrated lightning of White Pure pierced Surya's chest.
Crrrrunch!
With an explosive sound of something being crushed, my body, drained of every bit of magic power, flew through the sky.
Through Story fragments spraying into the air like a fountain, I saw Surya's massive body collapse.
[Surya! Supreme God of Light!]
Amid Oedipus's shout, the scene was crumbling.
Like a meteorite burning up upon striking the atmosphere, Surya's train began to disintegrate.
Rrrrrumble.
I fell toward the ground.
“Kim Dokja!”

Yoo Joonghyuk flew over like the wind and caught me, while the Chimera Dragon caught our falling companions on its back. It had been a very close call. Several fragments of the shattered last carriage streaked toward the ground, trailing long tails.
Booooom!
The fragments struck with thunderous explosions. Fortunately, they weren't enough to damage the [Industrial Complex].
From the Chimera Dragon's head, Shin Yoosung was looking at me.
“Ajusshi!”
Joy plainly visible on the child's face.
The next moment, a voice came from the haze of dust on the ground.
[Not yet! Not yet!]
It was King Oedipus.
Beside the fallen constellations, he shouted at us, looking wretched.
[Demon King of Salvation! I know you have not yet finished inheriting the ‘Giant Story’! If you hand the Story over to us even now, we will withdraw.]
Though the battle had already been decided, he refused to give up.
Yoo Joonghyuk answered in my place.
“Why should we?”
After landing, Yoo Joonghyuk set me on the ground and growled as he drew the [Black Heavenly Demon Sword]. Then King Oedipus said,
[Otherwise, your precious world will disappear.]
“Are you going to prattle about fate again? I know you have no probability left to invest in the Demon Realm.”
[What if it isn't the Demon Realm?]
He snapped his fingers, and a huge panel appeared in the air.
On it was a blue planet we knew well.
Yoo Joonghyuk frowned.
“It seems you've sold off every last scrap of a constellation's pride. Is this your final act of desperation?”
At this point, even if <Olympus> poured in all the probability it possessed, it couldn't destroy Earth. Yoo Joonghyuk knew that too, so he didn't look flustered at all. Then King Oedipus smiled.
[Blowing up Earth is beyond us. But how about this?]
He snapped his fingers again, and the image on the panel changed.
At the sight that appeared on the screen, the expressions of Yoo Joonghyuk and our companions hardened.
There was the Korean Peninsula, engulfed in a raging inferno (火魔).
“……If I'd known this would happen, maybe I should've gone to the Demon Realm too.”
Han Sooyoung frowned as she watched Gyeonggi Province burn in red and blue flames. In truth, there was a reason she hadn't gone to the Demon Realm.
[You are currently under the curse of the demon king ‘Andras’.]

Some time ago, Han Sooyoung had fallen for Kim Dokja's scheme and been cursed by a demon king. If she carelessly ventured into that region, she could end up as the demon king's next meal. Beside her, Lee Gilyoung stamped his feet and shouted.
“Everyone must be with Dokja-hyung by now, right? Lucky Shin Yoosung……”
“Probably. But they've likely got it worse over there.”
Han Sooyoung swallowed as she sensed the disaster approaching through the inferno.
After Dokja's companions had received ‘personal scenarios’ and left for the Demon Realm one by one, a ‘disaster scenario’ had struck the Korean Peninsula.
[30 minutes remain in the disaster scenario.]
The problem was that this time, the ‘disasters’ were constellations.
“Fucking Olympus.”
She didn't know what backroom deal they had made with the Dokkaebi Bureau, but the ‘disasters’ that had arrived for this ‘disaster scenario’ were constellations from <Olympus>.

Given the difficulty, the scenario was set to end if they could just survive for 30 minutes. Though at present, it seemed more likely that the Korean Peninsula would vanish from the face of the earth within those 30 minutes.
“……What now?”
Gong Pildu asked, exhaling cigarette smoke through his thick lips.
The Gyeonggi region had only held out this long thanks to Gong Pildu's [Armed Fortress], whose proficiency had risen sharply. Han Sooyoung answered.
“Hold out a little longer. I have a way.”
“We're up against the incarnation bodies of constellations. There are more than five of them. How the hell do you plan to win? Even that bastard Kim Dokja couldn't handle this.”
Judging by the energy she sensed, they were all Historical-grade constellations. They were probably ancient heroes of <Olympus>, or beings on par with lesser deities.
[It seems the people of this small land have just as little courage!]
The sheer reverberation of their Status made her head throb.
Han Sooyoung calmly took several pitch-black stones from inside her clothes.
[Abyss Stone].
It was an item Kim Dokja had told her to collect before they parted.
These items had allowed her to send their companions to the Demon Realm despite the lack of probability. She had used three so far, leaving six. She was a little short, but this was the only way.
“I might end up burning the whole house down trying to catch a bug……”
While Lee Gilyoung's insects protected the fortress and Gong Pildu's fortress kept up its barrage, Han Sooyoung began the descent ritual, offering the Abyss Stones as sacrifices.
If she could summon a being capable of balancing these crooked scales, even for a single moment.
Bzzzzzt!
Sparks flew as the Abyss Stones began to disappear one by one, sacrificed to probability.
A terrifying being who required no fewer than six Abyss Stones just to summon a fraction of its power.
Rrrrrumble!

The sky over Gyeonggi Province turned pitch-black, and thunder came crashing down. An immense Status was revealing its shadow behind Han Sooyoung. With a light sigh, she slowly opened her eyes and spoke.
“Flame Dragon. Do whatever you want.”
[The constellation ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon’ grins, baring white teeth.]
Having wiped out the area around Seongnam in an instant, Olympus's Historical-grade constellations were slowly tightening their encirclement around Gong Pildu's Armed Fortress.
[Don't you think this stage is too small for us?]
Every constellation looked humiliated. Understandably so. None of them had built up their Status to become material for a scenario like this.
Seeing their lack of enthusiasm, a constellation wearing an old crown and holding a crude ancient spear and shield spoke as though granting them a favor.
[Stop complaining. Father said that once this is over, he would try proposing our ‘promotion’ to the Twelve Gods.]
[Oedipus said that? Truly?]
The constellations' expressions changed at the words of ‘Blind King's Successor’.
A ‘promotion’ within a nebula meant an increase in one's share of its ‘Giant Story’.
[Hah, does that mean we can finally reach the first decimal place?]

The size of a constellation's ‘share of a Giant Story’ within a nebula was one measure of its strength. A greater share guaranteed more probability, which in turn allowed it to escape restrictions in more scenarios.
[Let's finish this quickly and return.]
The bantering constellations finally began their advance on the Armed Fortress.
The moment the Star Relics they each held shone in the air.
Rrrrrumble.
The light overhead vanished, as though a pitch-black dome had covered the sky.
As the eerie darkness descended, the Historical-grade constellations approaching the Armed Fortress stopped in unison.
[……What is this?]
Bzzzzzt!

The gathering black clouds were extinguishing every light in the area. Pitch-black darkness that enveloped not just this region but the entire Korean Peninsula. It was so deep that even the sparks of probability were obscured.
‘Blind King's Successor’ looked up at the sky in confusion and muttered.
[Could it be…… Your Majesty, Queen of the Underworld?]
<Olympus> was the only nebula that could currently descend upon the Korean Peninsula.
And among the constellations of <Olympus>, few could perform such a marvel with so little probability.
One of the Historical-grade constellations emitted a faint light to illuminate their surroundings, but it went out in an instant.
An ominous stillness fell, as though a black hole had descended and swallowed all the light.
The anxious constellations cried out.
[Your Majesty! If you are here, please speak―]
One of the constellations suddenly shouted a warning.
[Something's com……!]
Crack!
A pitch-black object shot down from the sky and pierced a constellation's chest.
[Guaaaagh……!]

It was shaped like a dragon's claw. Bleeding, the startled constellation tried to pull it out, but the claw grew larger and larger until it burst the constellation's entire torso apart. The constellation's incarnation body, reduced to a speck in the darkness with a crunch. The horrified constellations screamed.
[A-aaaargh!]
Even after hearing the sound, the constellation hadn't been able to dodge. Which meant……
That this was a being with a ‘Status’ on an entirely different plane from theirs.
Even the Queen of the Underworld wasn't this powerful.
[Everyone, run……!]
Realizing what was happening, ‘Blind King's Successor’ ordered a retreat.
Bzzzzzzt!

That was when tremendous sparks erupted from the Armed Fortress. Light too intense for the darkness to swallow illuminated the darkened city for an instant, revealing the fortress gates opening in the dim surroundings.
It was a woman of small stature.
‘Blind King's Successor’, the first to spot her, trembled.
[Wh-why are you……!]
A shadow of black flames billowed behind the woman. For a moment, the face of a small boy appeared, red eyes (赤眼) gleaming through the black hair covering his forehead.
Whoooosh!
As the boy with one arm wrapped in bandages raised his hand, the shadow of a pitch-black dragon covered the sky.
Fangs protruding among snow-white teeth.
When the boy smiled, the darkness of the world held its breath.
And the slaughter began.
King Oedipus couldn't hide his horror at the scene unfolding on the screen.
[The constellation ‘Blind King's Successor’ has exited the scenario.]
[The constellation ‘Gatekeeper of Thebes’ has exited the scenario.]
The dragon's shadow filled the screen with darkness, tearing every fleeing constellation to shreds.
Fortunately, it seemed Han Sooyoung hadn't been too late.
[The constellation ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon’ bursts into savage laughter.]
―Ahahahahahaha!

Han Sooyoung, one hand wrapped in bandages and half her face covered, bursting into bizarre laughter. She really was a perfect match for the Black Flame Dragon. I couldn't understand why she'd disliked him all this time when they could have so much fun together.
Belatedly coming to his senses, King Oedipus turned to me and shouted.
[How could this…… Why would a candidate of the Book of Revelation associate with the likes of you……!]
A candidate of the Book of Revelation……
Well, someone on the level of ‘King Oedipus’ would have access to that much information by now.
The Abyssal Black Flame Dragon was one of the candidates for the ‘Final Dragon of the Book of Revelation’.
[Many constellations marvel at your stratagem.]
[The constellation ‘Dragon Lying Down’ nods.]
[The constellation ‘Secretive Plotter’ is sincerely impressed.]
[You have acquired a new Story!]
[You have acquired the Story ‘Stratagem of Killing with a Borrowed Blade (借刀殺人之計)’.]
Watching Gyeonggi Province turn dark, I inwardly smacked my lips.
Bringing in the Abyssal Black Flame Dragon really had been a last resort.
One wrong step could have brought an even greater disaster.
Still, Han Sooyoung was there, and there was also the promise I'd made with the Black Flame Dragon, so he wouldn't destroy the Korean Peninsula.
[Ghh…… Uhh…….]
King Oedipus lowered his head and let out an inscrutable groan.
At that ominous sight, Yoo Joonghyuk and I raised our swords at the same time.
[You bastard……!]
King Oedipus's son had been among the constellations attacked by the Black Flame Dragon. We had to consider the possibility that the enraged Oedipus might lose control and charge at us.
[I'll kill you!]

As expected, Oedipus and the surviving constellations released their Status in unison. We had gained a ‘Giant Story’, but their forces were still formidable. Yet just as I was about to activate [Electrification] again, something rose from beneath the ground and seized Oedipus by the throat.
The massive Surya had moved one of his four arms to clamp a hand around Oedipus's throat. King Oedipus turned to stare at Surya in shock.
[Wh-why……!]
[……Enough.]
Surya's weighty ‘Status’ bore down on the other constellations.
[Do not disgrace yourselves any further.]
[I won't listen to a defeated dog! I cannot let it end like this……!]
The next moment, King Oedipus's body exploded.
His incarnation body had been brutally blown apart and was scattering into ash before Surya's eyes. The shocked constellations froze, and my tense companions took a step back.
To have that much strength left after such grievous injuries…… His vitality was truly astonishing.
I quickly calculated my remaining companions' fighting strength.
If we had to fight Surya right now……
[We have lost.]
For a moment, I thought I'd misheard.
But those words had unmistakably come from Surya's mouth.
I bit my lip at the sudden surge of elation deep within my chest.
That great <Lokapala> had admitted defeat in his own words.
[The winner of the ‘Demon King Selection’ has been determined.]
With the system message that followed, anguished cries rang out in the distance.
They were the screams of the dukes who had lost the ‘Demon King Selection’.
Sssssss……
One by one, the incarnation bodies of the constellations glaring at us dissolved.
With the scenario over, the <Star Stream> had begun reclaiming the probability it had granted them. Surya's body was disappearing too.
I opened my mouth before Surya's body vanished completely.
I wanted to ask him. Why had he suddenly changed his mind?
[Demon King of Salvation.]
But the moment I saw the look in Surya's eyes, I closed my mouth again.
Now that I thought about it, Surya was no ordinary constellation.
No ordinary constellation, but one of the great <Lokapala>.
It was stranger that a constellation with such a supreme modifier had resorted to every sort of cowardly trick against us in the first place.
This ‘Selection’ had probably dealt a tremendous blow to his Status and his pride.
Surya blinked slowly and asked.
[Have you obtained the ‘Qualification for the End’?]
“I probably will. And you too……”
Surya's eyes flashed fiercely, as if telling me to spare him such worthless consolation.
[I will be watching your Story.]
Surya, too, would someday obtain the ‘Qualification for the End’.
Then perhaps a day would come when we met again.
Not here, but far above, in the later scenarios of the <Star Stream>.
Fssssss……

For a brief moment, Surya's gaze shifted to the fallen wreckage of the train. It was debris from the car where Surya and I had clashed. But some of those fragments were shaped rather strangely. Those weren't traces of damage from his battle with me.
Scars that had been etched into the train before then.
“I know.”
[I see. Very well.]

With those final words, Surya vanished. As all the oppressive Status around us disappeared at once, a strange stillness settled over the area. It didn't feel real. I had calmly carried out my plans, and luck had helped with a few things.
And we had made it this far.
[The twenty-fifth main scenario has ended.]
When I turned my head, Yoo Joonghyuk was also looking at the place where Surya had disappeared.
[You have cleared the main scenario ― ‘Demon King Selection’.]
[The rewards for this selection are being prepared.]
[A new demon king has appeared in the Demon Realm!]
[You have become the owner of the ‘73rd Demon Realm’!]
As system messages poured forth in an explosive flood, Yoo Joonghyuk and I looked up at the sky together. The gazes of countless beings rained down on me from above.
[The demon king ‘Ruler of Eastern Hell’ looks at you.]
[The demon king ‘Demon God of Necromancy’ takes an interest in you.]
[The demon king ‘Black Mane Lion’ invites you to their Demon Realm.]
[The constellation ‘Mass Production Maker’ sends congratulations.]
[The constellation ‘Queen of the Darkest Spring’ has sent you a gift.]
[The constellation ‘God of Wine and Ecstasy’ proposes a toast.]
[The constellation ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’ is overjoyed.]
[The constellation ‘Commander of the Red Cosmos’ is wary of you.]
There were incomparably more gazes upon me than ever before.
From powerful beings on a level similar to mine to beings so far beyond me that, as I was now, I couldn't even look upon their toes.
Jang Hayoung slumped to the ground with a thud and spoke in a dazed voice.
“……It's over.”
I nodded and looked around at my companions.
Lee Hyunsung was looking at the sky with Jung Heewon on his back. Lee Jihye waved at me as she supported the injured Yoo Sangah, and Shin Yoosung looked up at me, holding on to my sleeve.

The Breaking the Sky Sword Master gave a soft bark with the limp Osu held in its mouth. And behind them, Han Myungoh was panting in exhaustion, cradling Asmodeus's incarnation body. I had no idea how long he'd been there.
I could also see the Breaking the Sky Sword Saint and Kyrgios on a rocky hill a short distance away.
And the ‘Brash Swamp Predator’, his injured body curled up, with Cheok Jungyeong perched on his back.
Had even one of them been missing, we could never have overcome this ordeal.
[Your group's ‘nebula’ is becoming widely known throughout the <Star Stream>.]
[Many constellations have committed the nebula ‘Kim Dokja’s Company (Temporary)’ to memory.]
Yoo Joonghyuk frowned at the message.
“……We'll have to change the name first.”
I grinned at him. He insisted on asserting his pride over the strangest things.
I thought it might not be a bad idea to hold a contest soon for the constellations to name our nebula.
I could see the deep darkness receding beyond the sky.
The ordeals that had seemed as though they would never end were pausing to catch their breath.
[Your first ‘Giant Story’ fully blossoms.]
[You have acquired the Giant Story ‘Demon Realm's Spring’.]

In the ruined industrial complex of the Demon Realm, citizens were emerging from the fortress one by one. People intoxicated by an unbelievable victory. Someone cheered, and someone else chanted my name and Yoo Joonghyuk's. I could see Aileen and Mark too.
[The <Star Stream> is satisfied with your ‘Giant Story’.]
[You have acquired the ‘Qualification for the End’.]
At last, the messages I had been waiting for rang out.
[Hidden scenario ― ‘A Single Story’ is beginning!]
[Your Legendary-grade Stories form the prologue.]
[Your first Giant Story has completed ‘Introduction (起)’!]
After a long, patient wait, the first step toward the final scenario had at last been taken.
[You are granted ■■ privileges.]
[The filtering on ■■ is lifted.]
It was the moment when information about the final chapter, veiled for so long, finally revealed itself before my eyes.
